Alembic migration script to add and remove indices on the "derived_contents" table.

# Purpose
This code is a database migration script using Alembic, a database migration tool for SQLAlchemy. It defines an [`upgrade`](<#upgrade>) function to create two non-unique indices on the `derived_contents` table, specifically on the `codebase_id` and `workspace_id` columns. The [`downgrade`](<#downgrade>) function reverses these changes by dropping the same indices. The script includes revision identifiers, `revision` and `down_revision`, which Alembic uses to track the migration's position in the sequence of database changes. This script provides narrow functionality focused on managing database schema changes.
